title: Tiberius
summary: Roman emperor. Jones dates a co-rex accession and, later, his sole rule after Augustus.
description: Roman emperor. Jones dates a co-rex accession and, later, his sole rule after Augustus. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament) prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (4015 12 1st year of Tiberius as co-rex). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

reign.note: Jones prints the first year as co-rex. Luke 3:1 names Tiberius Caesar and does not date the co-regency. Appendix F prints no end year, so no span is stored.
